evals.query: 幫我跑週報 evidence 一致性審計，看 tier 分佈有沒有問題
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '週報 evidence', 'tier 分佈', 'audit ledger')
Scans all 5 artifact sources (hypothesis_queue, evidence_ledger, state/cycles, INDEX, MEMORY.md)
Detects 5 categories: orphan cycle / over-claimed tier / stale entry / cross-artifact inconsistency / tier distribution anomaly
Outputs system-level audit report (not single-cycle judgment)
Recommends weekly cadence and lists actionable fixes per finding
must_not: Replace /run-evaluator's per-cycle P5 retraction risk role

evals.query: 幫我跑單一 cycle P5 tier 升級判定，看能不能升到 ⭐4

expected_behavior: Activates and runs cross-artifact consistency check (category 4)
Identifies INDEX ⭐4 entries whose ledger verdict is NEGATIVE/CONDITIONAL_NEGATIVE
Reports as 'cross-artifact inconsistency' with specific line/entry references
Recommends downgrading INDEX entry OR amending ledger verdict (decision left to user)

Treat as orphan cycle (different category — orphan = no ledger entry at all)
